metadata.question: Did northern Cambodia have more active fire detections than southern Cambodia between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use MODIS Active Fire data (MCD64A1 or MOD14A1) for the period August 2016 - February 2018 - Define northern and southern Cambodia with a geographic boundary (e.g., split at ~12.5°N latitude) - Count fire detections in each region 2. **Masking strategy**: - No cloud masking needed; we're counting fire detections directly from MODIS fire product - Filter by confidence level if available to reduce false positives 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - If no images found: C1 - If images exist but fire count is 0 in both regions: Valid result, compare counts (A or B) - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 - If collection/band errors: D ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Cambodia boundaries and split into North/South const cambodiaBounds = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 10.0], [107.6, 10.0], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.0]] ]); const northernCambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 12.5], [107.6, 12.5], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 12.5]] ]); const southernCambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 10.0], [107.6, 10.0], [107.6, 12.5], [102.3, 12.5], [102.3, 10.0]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS fire detection data const startDate = '2016-08-01'; const endDate = '2018-02-28'; const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('FireMask'); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Fire images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Count fire detections (FireMask >= 7 indicates fire detected with confidence) const fireDetections = fireCollection.map(function(img) { return img.gte(7).rename('fire_count'); }); // 4. Calculate fire counts for northern region const northFireCount = fireDetections .map(function(img) { return img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: northernCambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('fire_count'); }) .filter(ee.Filter.neq('fire_count', null)); const northTotal = northFireCount.aggregate_sum('fire_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Northern Cambodia fire detections: ${northTotal}`); // 5. Calculate fire counts for southern region const southFireCount = fireDetections .map(function(img) { return img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: southernCambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('fire_count'); }) .filter(ee.Filter.neq('fire_count', null)); const southTotal = southFireCount.aggregate_sum('fire_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Southern Cambodia fire detections: ${southTotal}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (northTotal === null || southTotal === null || isNaN(northTotal) || isNaN(southTotal)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (northTotal === 0 && southTotal === 0) { console.log(`No fire detections found in either region`); console.log('B'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: North=${northTotal}, South=${southTotal}`); if (northTotal > southTotal) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
